data.name: Nalati Grasslands
data.label: (+4, −2)
data.blurb: SUPER EXPERIMENTAL — the Tian Shan steppe, painted: cross the braided Kunes, tame a steppe horse and hunt wolves from the saddle across the golden bowl of the Sky Grassland, break the Golden King in his kurgan, and ride out a storm to face the Storm Titan. Snow Lotus Valley waits in the snow ring. Built live, rough edges everywhere.
